issues.description: Constructor parameter order for class Meal is inconsistent across artifacts. The problem statement UML and the solution repository define the constructor as Meal(String name, String[] ingredients) (name first, ingredients second). The template repository implements the constructor with the parameters reversed: Meal(String[] ingredients, String name). The template's Main usage (new Meal("cowBoyStew", new String[]{...})) also follows the name-first order, so the template constructor order will cause compilation confusion or errors for students following the specification and example code.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template Meal constructor to match the problem statement and the solution: change the signature to public Meal(String name, String[] ingredients) and assign the fields accordingly (this.name = name; this.ingredients = ingredients;). Alternatively, if the reversed order was intentional, update the problem statement and example usages (Main) to use the reversed parameter order, but the recommended fix is to align the template with the problem statement and solution so students can compile and run the provided example code.
